title: Hook
text: Look closely at this face. Two round eyes sit right at the front of its head, and below them a small slit of a mouth hangs open in what looks like permanent surprise.
nxt: It looks like a clay project that went slightly wrong.

title: From Museum Case to Meme
text: The model sits in the Finnish Museum of Natural History in Helsinki.
nxt: A photo of it went viral on Twitter in 2022, and in 2023 people in Japan fell in love with it.

title: The Woman Who Made It
text: The model was made by the Estonian palaeontologist Elga Mark-Kurik for a fossil fish exhibit that opened in 1995.
nxt: She was a scientist, not a professional sculptor.

title: Eyes at the Very Front
text: Now to the famous face. In the fossils, the eyes sit at the very front of the head, close together, each one supported by a ring of bone.
nxt: Most fish today have eyes on the sides of the head, which gives a wide view of danger.

title: What the Model Cannot Know
text: There is one more catch. Soft tissues like retinas and lenses almost never survive in fossils.
nxt: So nobody knows what the eyes of a living Sacabambaspis looked like.

title: More Than a Meme
text: So the next time that face appears in your feed, smile, but also look a little closer.
nxt: This is a real animal, with a real armor of bone, and a place on the family tree of backboned life. It was not a joke of nature.
